plugins.name: pipenet
plugins.title: Pipe network
plugins.description: Lay out a fluid loop on a grid: one source, any number of sinks, joined by straights, elbows, tees and crossovers in schedule pipe sizes, with the return the same as the supply or laid out on a side of its own. Writes each side's upstream matrix and segment lengths, bores and fitting counts into the sheet, for Crane, Hooper 2-K or Darby 3-K fitting losses, and draws the sheet's flows and pressure drops on the pipes. Comes with the sheet that solves the loop.
